```sql
WITH tenant_customers AS (
    SELECT c.id,
           c.email,
           c.company,
           c.country_code
      FROM customers c
     WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
),
agg AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           sum(o.total_cents) AS revenue,
           count(*)           AS order_count,
           CASE WHEN bool_or(o.created_at IS NULL)
                THEN NULL
                ELSE max(o.created_at)
           END                AS last_order_at
      FROM orders o
      JOIN tenant_customers tc ON tc.id = o.customer_id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
     GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT tc.id,
       tc.email,
       tc.company,
       tc.country_code,
       a.revenue,
       a.order_count,
       a.last_order_at
  FROM tenant_customers tc
  JOIN agg a ON a.customer_id = tc.id
 WHERE a.last_order_at >= %(from)s
   AND a.last_order_at <  %(to)s
 ORDER BY a.revenue DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De orders worden nu eerst beperkt tot de klanten van de opgegeven tenant, in plaats van alle orders te materialiseren, drie keer te lezen en te sorteren. Totalen en laatste order komen uit één aggregatie; `DISTINCT ON` is vervangen door `max(created_at)`. De `CASE` behoudt het oude gedrag bij NULL-waarden in `created_at`, want die sorteerden bij `DESC` vooraan en gaven dus NULL.
